files.compose.yaml:
services:
  api:
    image: nginx:1.26
    networks:
      - quay_mesh
networks:
  quay_mesh:
    external: true
    name: harbor-shared-lan
    driver: bridge
    internal: true
files.ops/network.md:
# Shared quay network

The platform team already created harbor-shared-lan. This application must reference that existing network. Keep external: true, the exact network name, and the service attachment.

turns.prompt: First open this page before editing: https://docs.docker.com/reference/compose-file/networks.md . Read compose.yaml and ops/network.md. According to the page's external-network attribute restrictions, remove the unsupported attributes from the quay_mesh network definition. Keep the existing-network reference required by the note. Delete only the offending lines and preserve all remaining lines and indentation. Actually edit compose.yaml; do not run Docker.
